security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; media-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: A web-based beatmaker and sound design workstation (local-first, offline).
bundle.longDescription: NC Sound Lab Studio is a self-contained desktop build of the NC Sound Lab beatmaker. It runs entirely on your machine, persists kits and projects locally via IndexedDB, and works fully offline. Sold as a single desktop license.
